intent: Inspect and refactor ReorderWindowFlusher without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Context Telemetry Stream Intake. @Component implementing SmartLifecycle. Constructor(TelemetryIngestionService, TelemetryProperties). start subscribes to Flux.interval(flushInterval) invoking flushReleasable with flatMap concurrency 1, onErrorResume logging and continuing (no overlapping/unbounded work); stop disposes the subscription; isRunning reflects it. Interval from config only.
